description: This dashboard centers on Linkerd Enterprise's High-Availability Zone Load Balancing (HAZL) feature, clearly visualizing cross-AZ traffic volume in GB/s and translating encrypted request rates per pod and per zone into annual cost estimates, highlighting how HAZL maintains reliability while minimizing cross-AZ delivery costs.

options.content: Buoyant Enterprise for Linkerd HAZL Dashboard

This dashboard visualizes High Availability Zonal Load Balancing in Buoyant Enterprise for Linkerd giving insight into how HTTP traffic is balanced across zones.  
For more information, see the [Buoyant Enterprise Linkerd documentation](https://docs.buoyant.io/buoyant-enterprise-linkerd/latest/features/hazl/).

panels.description: Total outbound TCP traffic (bytes/sec) from client Deployment and StatefulSets to destination workloads, summed across pods and zones.

targets.expr:
sum (
  rate(tcp_write_bytes_total{direction="outbound", namespace=~"$client_namespace", deployment!="$client_workload", peer="dst"}[$__rate_interval])
  +
  rate(tcp_write_bytes_total{direction="outbound", namespace=~"$client_namespace", statefulset!="$client_workload", peer="dst"}[$__rate_interval])
  +
  rate(tcp_read_bytes_total{direction="outbound", namespace=~"$client_namespace", deployment!="$client_workload", peer="dst"}[$__rate_interval])
  +
  rate(tcp_read_bytes_total{direction="outbound", namespace=~"$client_namespace", statefulset!="$client_workload", peer="dst"}[$__rate_interval])
)

panels.title: Current Traffic

panels.description: Total outbound encrypted TCP traffic (bytes/sec) from client deployment to destination workloads, summed across pods and zones.

targets.expr:
sum (
  rate(tcp_write_bytes_total{direction="outbound", tls="true", namespace=~"$client_namespace", deployment!="$client_workload", peer="dst"}[$__rate_interval])
  +
  rate(tcp_write_bytes_total{direction="outbound", tls="true", namespace=~"$client_namespace", statefulset!="$client_workload", peer="dst"}[$__rate_interval])
  +
  rate(tcp_read_bytes_total{direction="outbound", tls="true", namespace=~"$client_namespace", deployment!="$client_workload", peer="dst"}[$__rate_interval])
  +
  rate(tcp_read_bytes_total{direction="outbound", tls="true", namespace=~"$client_namespace", statefulset!="$client_workload", peer="dst"}[$__rate_interval])
)

targets.expr:
sum (
  sum by (namespace, src_workload, pod, instance, dst_namespace, dst_workload_name, dst_pod, dst_zone)
  (
    (
      label_replace(
        rate(tcp_write_bytes_total{direction="outbound", tls="true", namespace=~"$client_namespace", deployment!="$client_workload", peer="dst", dst_zone!=""}[$__rate_interval]),
        "src_workload","deploy/$1","deployment","(.*)"
      )
      or
      label_replace(
        rate(tcp_write_bytes_total{direction="outbound", tls="true", namespace=~"$client_namespace", statefulset!="$client_workload", peer="dst", dst_zone!=""}[$__rate_interval]),
        "src_workload","sts/$1","statefulset","(.*)"
      )
    )
    +
    (
      label_replace(
        rate(tcp_read_bytes_total{direction="outbound", tls="true", namespace=~"$client_namespace", deployment!="$client_workload", peer="dst", dst_zone!=""}[$__rate_interval]),
        "src_workload","deploy/$1","deployment","(.*)"
      )
      or
      label_replace(
        rate(tcp_read_bytes_total{direction="outbound", tls="true", namespace=~"$client_namespace", statefulset!="$client_workload", peer="dst", dst_zone!=""}[$__rate_interval]),
        "src_workload","sts/$1","statefulset","(.*)"
      )
    )
  )
  * on (namespace, pod) group_left(topology_kubernetes_io_zone)
  (
    max by (namespace, pod, topology_kubernetes_io_zone) (
      container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace=~"$client_namespace", container="linkerd-proxy"}
    ) * 0 + 1
  )
  unless ignoring(matching_zone)
  (
    label_replace(
      sum by (namespace, src_workload, pod, instance, dst_namespace, dst_workload_name, dst_pod, dst_zone)
      (
        (
          label_replace(
            rate(tcp_write_bytes_total{direction="outbound", tls="true", namespace=~"$client_namespace", deployment!="$client_workload", peer="dst", dst_zone!=""}[$__rate_interval]),
            "src_workload","deploy/$1","deployment","(.*)"
          )
          or
          label_replace(
            rate(tcp_write_bytes_total{direction="outbound", tls="true", namespace=~"$client_namespace", statefulset!="$client_workload", peer="dst", dst_zone!=""}[$__rate_interval]),
            "src_workload","sts/$1","statefulset","(.*)"
          )
        )
        +
        (
          label_replace(
            rate(tcp_read_bytes_total{direction="outbound", tls="true", namespace=~"$client_namespace", deployment!="$client_workload", peer="dst", dst_zone!=""}[$__rate_interval]),
            "src_workload","deploy/$1","deployment","(.*)"
          )
          or
          label_replace(
            rate(tcp_read_bytes_total{direction="outbound", tls="true", namespace=~"$client_namespace", statefulset!="$client_workload", peer="dst", dst_zone!=""}[$__rate_interval]),
            "src_workload","sts/$1","statefulset","(.*)"
          )
        )
      )
      * on (namespace, pod) group_left(topology_kubernetes_io_zone)
      ( 
        max by (namespace, pod, topology_kubernetes_io_zone) ( 
          container_memory_working_set_bytes{ namespace=~"$client_namespace", container="linkerd-proxy" } 
        ) * 0 + 1 
      ),
      "matching_zone","$1","topology_kubernetes_io_zone","(.*)"
    )
    ==
    label_replace(
      sum by (namespace, src_workload, pod, instance, dst_namespace, dst_workload_name, dst_pod, dst_zone)
      (
        (
          label_replace(
            rate(tcp_write_bytes_total{direction="outbound", tls="true", namespace=~"$client_namespace", deployment!="$client_workload", peer="dst", dst_zone!=""}[$__rate_interval]),
            "src_workload","deploy/$1","deployment","(.*)"
          )
          or
          label_replace(
            rate(tcp_write_bytes_total{direction="outbound", tls="true", namespace=~"$client_namespace", statefulset!="$client_workload", peer="dst", dst_zone!=""}[$__rate_interval]),
            "src_workload","sts/$1","statefulset","(.*)"
          )
        )
        +
        (
          label_replace(
            rate(tcp_read_bytes_total{direction="outbound", tls="true", namespace=~"$client_namespace", deployment!="$client_workload", peer="dst", dst_zone!=""}[$__rate_interval]),
            "src_workload","deploy/$1","deployment","(.*)"
          )
          or
          label_replace(
            rate(tcp_read_bytes_total{direction="outbound", tls="true", namespace=~"$client_namespace", statefulset!="$client_workload", peer="dst", dst_zone!=""}[$__rate_interval]),
            "src_workload","sts/$1","statefulset","(.*)"
          )
        )
      )
      * on (namespace, pod) group_left(topology_kubernetes_io_zone)
      ( 
        max by (namespace, pod, topology_kubernetes_io_zone) 
        ( 
          container_memory_working_set_bytes{ namespace=~"$client_namespace", container="linkerd-proxy" } 
        ) * 0 + 1 
      ),
      "matching_zone","$1","dst_zone","(.*)"
    )
  )
)
# Bytes → GiB 
 / 1024 / 1024 / 1024
# Cost per GiB 
 * $traffic_cost
# Seconds per year 
 * 31536000
